description: This file defines a data dictionary class for Firebird within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes methods for type mapping, quoting identifiers, creating databases, generating SQL for table creation, triggers, and altering columns specific to Firebird databases.

classes.name: ADODB2_firebird
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict tailored for Firebird database-specific SQL generation and schema operations.

methods.name: actualType
methods.description: Maps generic meta types to Firebird-specific data types, supporting custom meta types if configured.

methods.name: nameQuote
methods.description: Quotes database identifiers according to Firebird conventions, supports backtick quoting and special character handling.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Returns SQL commands to declare functions and initialize a new Firebird database.

methods.name: _dropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop auto-increment sequences associated with a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix clauses for column defaults, constraints, and nullability.

methods.name: createTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating a table with fields, primary keys, indexes, and triggers.

methods.name: _triggers
methods.description: Creates SQL for sequences and triggers to implement auto-increment behavior on tables.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter existing table columns, includes type modifications and index re-creation.
